limitations: Original-game behavior and native callers are not observed by this exporter.
MNU coordinates are local source geometry. Screen placement and dynamic bitmap frame selection need separate native evidence.
DGP primary and indexed layers remain separate. Indexed additive pixels need lighter blending after primary drawing.
Exported DGP inverse-mask images are explicit candidates pending native per-resource blending confirmation.
No screenshot pixels are used in game assets. User screenshot observations are separate reference evidence.

semantic_bindings.evidence_boundary: Resource aliases combine source-pixel visual inspection and retained native static drawing evidence. No original execution was observed.

wheel.slot_limit: Rects identify original sensor regions. Actual command placement is dynamic and must follow the loaded command layout; position alone does not prove action semantics.

ally_status.origin_binding_limit: 0x42efc0 directly confirms the first table pair. Remaining pairs are observed contiguous source coordinates; all four native event callbacks should corroborate slot association.

ordinary_phase.color_intermediate: u8 floor(unfilled_height*255/23); signed-byte c=(255-2*intermediate), negative c becomes 0

preparation_phase.limit: Preserved native two-phase formula; color channel order and signed-byte wrapping should be corroborated at the 0x51e854/0x5394cd callers before claiming exact pixel equivalence.

default_commands.limit: These are new-game defaults, corroborated by two retained original saves. All seven slots can be rebound; consume the current slot type/id instead of hard-coding these positions.
